Criterion: Verify, if unoccupied cargo holds are present, that fire protection, fire detection/suppression, and smoke detector requirements are met. Standard: Unoccupied cargo holds meet fire protection zone definition and criteria. Hazard analysis determines the requirements for fire detection, suppression and smoke detection for unoccupied cargo holds. Method of Compliance: Analysis, ground and flight test verify unoccupied cargo holds incorporate adequate fire protection, detection and suppression . Ground and flight test verify smoke detection performance.
